title: Marketplaces
meta: A marketplace platform that connects buyers and sellers, with listings, profiles and messaging. From $400, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Marketplace platforms that connect buyers and sellers
overview: We build the first version of a two-sided marketplace: seller accounts, listings with photos, search, buyer accounts and messaging between the two. We agree your business rules first, such as who can list, how listings are approved and how fees work. The result is a working site on your own hosting, ready to test with a small group before you open it up.

pkgs.blurb: A working first version with listings, accounts and search.
A payment-ready marketplace with fees, payouts and moderation tools.
